_meta.purpose: DRAFT dataset for review before building the app. Compiled by AI agents researching official issuer pages (cross-checked with NerdWallet/The Points Guy/Bankrate/CNBC Select) on 2026-08-19. Do NOT treat as final — see 'flags' on each card for items worth a manual spot-check, and note that annual fees/perks change over time and welcome bonuses in particular are volatile promotional offers. Extended 2026-08-21 with 5 lower-tier, non-travel cards (Discover it Cash Back/Miles, TD Cash/Double Up/Clear) at the user's request. Apple Card added 2026-08-21 as a single-tier no-fee card.
